mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_result (batch_id, case_id, source_kind, platform, bot_id, group_id, turn_id, trace_id, score, decision, explanation, attribution, judge_model) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{caseId}, #{sourceKind}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{turnId}, #{traceId}, #{score}, #{decision}, #{explanation}, #{attribution}, #{judgeModel})
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_id AS batchId, case_id AS caseId, source_kind AS sourceKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, turn_id AS turnId, trace_id AS traceId, score, decision, explanation, attribution, judge_model AS judgeModel, created_at AS createdAt FROM eval_result WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, batch_id AS batchId, case_id AS caseId, source_kind AS sourceKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, turn_id AS turnId, trace_id AS traceId, score, decision, explanation, attribution, judge_model AS judgeModel, created_at AS createdAt FROM eval_result WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, batch_id AS batchId, case_id AS caseId, source_kind AS sourceKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, turn_id AS turnId, trace_id AS traceId, score, decision, explanation, attribution, judge_model AS judgeModel, created_at AS createdAt FROM eval_result WHERE source_kind = 'blind' AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, batch_id AS batchId, case_id AS caseId, source_kind AS sourceKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, turn_id AS turnId, trace_id AS traceId, score, decision, explanation, attribution, judge_model AS judgeModel, created_at AS createdAt FROM eval_result WHERE decision = 'badcase' AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
